name: Mark II EWHB-10
description: The Mark II EWHB-10, also known as the Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon or simply the Mark II Medium Blaster, was a blaster cannon produced by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.. It was a variant of the E-Web heavy repeating blaster cannon. Rebel Alliance forces used the Mark II EWHB-10 at Echo Base during the battle of Hoth.
